additional_info.body:
Hello Vanshika, good afternoon.
Thank you for sharing this information.
The chargers are no longer reporting a high volume of logs. Sometimes when we are rebooting the charger, depending on how it was shutdown, some logs from a few days ago are reported again as a fail safe measurement.
Since the errors are no longer present, I will close the ticket.
Thank you.
Best regards,
Francisco
